Search by roll number or name
Student roll number (e.g. 25CS101). When provided returns a single student record.

request.description: Records a fee payment. All breakdown amounts are validated against **concession-adjusted net totals** — the net amount after enrollment-based concessions (firstGraduate, scheme7point5, pmss, sakthi, special) have been applied to each fee category. Attempting to pay more than the remaining net due returns HTTP 400 with a message like: `"tuition payment ₹X exceeds remaining concession-adjusted due ₹Y for Semester N (YYYY-YYYY)"`.
